name: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn't make it
summary: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

name: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
summary: The ride share giant previously deployed a much smaller pilot for ChatGPT Work, but is now taking the enterprise agent company-wide.

name: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
summary: Masad said the decision was made for a number of different reasons, including cost. Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August, but there was never any indication that it was no longer partnering with Anthropic.

name: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
summary: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.

name: Insight Partners' Deven Parekh on why the firm is diversifying while everyone else bets the farm on OpenAI and Anthropic
summary: Insight Partners' Devin Parekh opens up about losing Legora to General Catalyst, why he's fine holding stakes in rival AI labs, and why — even as everyone else piles into OpenAI and Anthropic — his $90 billion firm is deliberately staying diversified.

name: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
summary: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.

name: Claude Duet app is Anthropic's bet on agents
summary: Claude Duet is available through waitlist for Pro and Max plan users

name: Ramp reaches $60B valuation as it pushes deeper into AI
summary: The funding comes as Ramp's annualized revenue crosses $2B, and its customer count reaches 85,000.

name: Anthropic's Claude AI submitted false murder tip to Philadelphia police
summary: “I may have information regarding this case," Claude AI told Philly police.

name: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
summary: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the mostly highly valued private company ever.
